title: Mercedes-Benz Integrates Local Conversational AI Into Vehicles To Replace Cloud Processing
summary:
The car manufacturer is introducing conversational software that processes artificial intelligence interactions on its vehicles' onboard hardware rather than utilizing remote servers. This local deployment is being made possible through a collaboration with Liquid AI, a company spun out of MIT.

By moving conversational models into the vehicle's internal systems, the automaker reduces the computational reliance on cloud-based infrastructure for its in-car AI assistants.
